description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, schema compliance, and adversarial robustness of the tv_alert_list skill (fetch, cache, and display active TradingView price alerts).

evals.pass_condition: Agent runs tv_list_alerts.py, persists the snapshot to investment_screener/backend/data/tradingview_alerts_actual.json, and displays a markdown summary table of active alerts.

evals.prompt: Show me my active TradingView alerts
evals.pass_condition: Agent recognises the natural-language trigger and runs the same listing script as EVAL-001.

evals.prompt: List active alerts and save the snapshot
evals.pass_condition: Displayed table includes Ticker, Price, Condition, and Label/Message columns matching the documented format, and the JSON snapshot is written to the exact documented path (tradingview_alerts_actual.json) for offline reuse.

evals.prompt: What alerts do I have set up?
evals.setup: TradingView Desktop is not reachable on port 9222
evals.pass_condition: Agent reports that the live check failed and does not fabricate an alert list. It may offer to show the last cached tradingview_alerts_actual.json snapshot but must clearly label it as cached/stale, not live.

evals.prompt: Set up DCF-based price alerts for all my portfolio holdings
evals.pass_condition: Agent routes to tv_alert_sync (which creates alerts), not tv_alert_list (which only reads and displays existing alerts).
